Malaysia Production & Regulatory Mapping
Prototype mapping for design discussion only; applicability and implementation require product-specific compliance review.
BNM Responsible Financing · BNM/RH/PD 028-95
Prototype policy uses total DSR ≤ 50% and checks residual Net Disposable Income (NDI); the 50% ceiling is a project policy assumption, not a universal BNM cap. Use reducing-balance amortization assumptions. Prepare for applicable flat-rate / Rule of 78 restrictions taking effect in 2027; do not treat this prototype as compliance evidence.
BNM Policy Document on Personal Financing
BNM FTFC · MAS FEAT
Govern fair treatment and proxy-variable impact testing; retain interpretable TreeSHAP adverse-action drivers, clear explanations, human review and an applicant appeal path. Sensitive attribute coverage remains a material limitation. See the CCRIS 12-month repayment record description.
BNM Fair Treatment · MAS FEAT
CCRIS · CTOS mapping
Map bureau_active_max_dpd and active_bureau_monthly_debt to CCRIS repayment history / existing commitments for validation. External inquiries and historical delinquency may inform CTOS-style score or trade-reference checks, subject to lawful access and data reconciliation.
MFRS 9 ECL bridge
Conceptual mapping: 12-month PIT recalibrated PD → Stage 1 ECL; SICR trigger → Stage 2 lifetime PD; S3/S4 macro stress multipliers → forward-looking macro overlays. This is not an ECL calculation or accounting conclusion.
